cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Would you be honorary patron of our roof appeal? You'd open it and thank the donors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can come, but I won't make a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then accept the patron's ribbon and lead the applause. That can be your ceremonial duty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave after the first donation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The patron applauds every donor. We couldn't have the later ones thinking their money mattered less.

mechanism: A copies moth-clapping as welcoming a patron, then adapts duties so B participation feels ceremonially binding.
confusable: D175 binds through a ceremonial role; D169 binds through shared responsibility for outcome.
comparison: Lantern succession versus roof appeal applause without a speech.
seedUse: Keep B no-speech boundary and first-donation exit as causes of adapted duty and duration.
